description: Braspace is a Brazilian team from Uberlândia passionate about space exploration, AI, and innovation. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we're tackling the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge, combining software engineering, geospatial data, AI, and interactive visualization to explore lunar landing opportunities. We welcome curious, collaborative minds skilled in Python, AI/ML, GIS, data science, astronomy, UX/UI, and 3D visualization. Let's build the future of lunar exploration together!
